Remove the ownership check so anyone can trigger withdrawal to the provided recipient.
Reverse the ownership check to require the caller is NOT the owner, preventing owner from calling withdrawAll while allowing others.
Transfer only half of the contract balance to the provided recipient instead of the full balance.
Insert clearing the owner before transfer, making transfer go to recipient but owner becomes zero address (observable later).
Change transfer target to the msg.sender instead of the provided recipient.
